description.ru: A C# mod: a Harmony patch adds a mark to the main menu title, a HUD line shows the play time and how many games were started (kept in the save), a main menu line, the console command 'excode', and with ModAPI 1.1 a log line with the player's origin and place read from the simulation. Source in src/, built by tools/build.ps1.
description.en: A C# mod: a Harmony patch adds a mark to the main menu title, a HUD line shows the play time and how many games were started (kept in the save), a main menu line, the console command 'excode', and with ModAPI 1.1 a log line with the player's origin and place read from the simulation. Source in src/, built by tools/build.ps1.

description.ru: Changes the same field as example_data (the medkit's heal, to 10) and loads after it, so its value wins. The mod manager and the console command 'mods conflicts' show the conflict.
description.en: Changes the same field as example_data (the medkit's heal, to 10) and loads after it, so its value wins. The mod manager and the console command 'mods conflicts' show the conflict.

description.ru: A data mod, JSON only. It raises the medkit's heal from 25 to 40, adds the tag "rare" to it with $insert, removes "consumable" with $remove, adds a new item 'Large medkit' made from the medkit with $base, and renames the medkit in English and Russian.
description.en: A data mod, JSON only. It raises the medkit's heal from 25 to 40, adds the tag "rare" to it with $insert, removes "consumable" with $remove, adds a new item 'Large medkit' made from the medkit with $base, and renames the medkit in English and Russian.

description.ru: A data mod, JSON only. It adds the origin 'Exile' with its own character 'Drifter': a smaller galaxy, a start on a barren or arctic world near a faction's border, everyone a little hostile. Pick it in New game.
description.en: A data mod, JSON only. It adds the origin 'Exile' with its own character 'Drifter': a smaller galaxy, a start on a barren or arctic world near a faction's border, everyone a little hostile. Pick it in New game.

description.ru: Requires example_data (version 1.x) and changes the item that mod adds: the large medkit gets cheaper. Enabling it enables example_data too; disabling example_data disables it.
description.en: Requires example_data (version 1.x) and changes the item that mod adds: the large medkit gets cheaper. Enabling it enables example_data too; disabling example_data disables it.
